title: Section 7.5 push-to-maximum diagnostic
subtitle: Disk support, normalize_coords = True, d = d_max(r), clean step and curved-edge stimuli

config.apparatus_reduction: Clean diagnostic metrics are evaluated on centered local patches rather than full 1024^2 frames. The largest support radius is 50 px, the evaluation masks are confined to a local tangent-normal neighborhood around each feature, and the patch fully contains every neighborhood that can influence the reported RMSE values.
